title: Official Alcatraz Tour and Golden Gate Bridge Bike Ride
includes: Round trip ferry rides to the Alcatraz Island
Option to upgrade to a one day e-bike (electric bike) rental with extra fees
Option to bike to Sausalito and return by ferry with extra fees
Unlimited time within the day to explore the Alcatraz Island on your own
Award-winning audio tour in multiple languages on the Alcatraz Island
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Two popular San Francisco activities in one! The first tour includes the world famous Alcatraz Island Prison Tour. The tour also includes a 45-minutes audio tour in different languages. You can stay on the Alcatraz Island as long as you like, and catch any returning ferry back to the wharf. 
The second part of this tour package includes the use of a bicycle to bike across the Golden Gate Bridge and/or anywhere you'd like to explore (self-guided). Each bike rental includes a helmet and a lock. The second activity can be done on the same day or on a different day. 

You will have the option to upgrade to a one day electric bike rental with extra fee once you are in the bike shop.

You will receive e-ticket for the Alcatraz tour. 
Location: Pier 33
Time: 3:50 pm
